beats.intent: A balance scale level with 3 x-boxes and 5 unit weights on the left, 20 unit weights on the right
beats.narration: Three boxes of x plus five weights balance twenty weights.
beats.code:
stage.title("Solving 3x + 5 = 20")
beam = Line([-4.5, 0, 0], [4.5, 0, 0], color=GREY_B, stroke_width=8)
pivot = Triangle(color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.8).scale(0.4).move_to([0, -0.35, 0])
stage.play(Create(beam), FadeIn(pivot))
stage.add(beam, pivot)
xs = VGroup(*[Square(0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1).move_to([-3.4, 0.4, 0])
ones = VGroup(*[Square(0.28, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.9) for _ in range(5)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.06).move_to([-1.4, 0.25, 0])
right = VGroup(*[Square(0.28, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.9) for _ in range(20)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=2, cols=10, buff=0.06).move_to([2.6, 0.4, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(xs), FadeIn(ones), FadeIn(right))
stage.add(xs, ones, right)
for b in xs:
    t = MathTex("x", font_size=30).move_to(b)
    stage.add(t)
stage.equation(r"3x + 5 = 20", where="center")

beats.intent: 5 weights taken off both sides, leaving 3 boxes against 15 weights
beats.narration: Take five weights off both sides. It still balances: three x equals fifteen.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(ones), *[FadeOut(right[k]) for k in range(15, 20)])
stage.equation(r"3x + 5 = 20", r"3x = 15")

beats.intent: The 15 weights split into 3 groups of 5, one per box, beside x = 5
beats.narration: Share the fifteen weights among the three boxes: five each. So x is five.
beats.code:
stage.play(*[right[k].animate.set_color([GREEN, ORANGE, RED][k // 5]) for k in range(15)])
stage.equation(r"3x + 5 = 20", r"3x = 15", r"x = 5")

request: how does a light switch on the stairs work from both ends?

beats.intent: Two switches A and B, each able to connect to an upper or lower wire, and a lamp
beats.narration: Stair lights use two switches, one at the bottom and one at the top, joined by two wires.
beats.code:
stage.title("Two-way switches")
wires = VGroup(Line([-2, 1, 0], [2, 1, 0], color=GREY_B), Line([-2, -1, 0], [2, -1, 0], color=GREY_B))
lamp = Circle(radius=0.45, color=YELLOW).move_to([4.8, 0, 0])
feedA = Line([-5, 0, 0], [-3.2, 0, 0], color=GREY_B)
feedB = Line([3.2, 0, 0], [4.35, 0, 0], color=GREY_B)
stage.play(Create(wires), Create(lamp), Create(feedA), Create(feedB))
stage.add(wires, lamp, feedA, feedB)
swA = Line([-3.2, 0, 0], [-2, 1, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)
swB = Line([3.2, 0, 0], [2, 1, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)
stage.play(Create(swA), Create(swB))
stage.add(swA, swB)
stage.label(swA, "A", direction=LEFT)
stage.label(swB, "B", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: Both switches on the upper wire: the circuit closes and the lamp lights
beats.narration: When both switches point to the same wire, current has a path and the lamp lights.
beats.code:
stage.play(wires[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW), feedA.animate.set_color(YELLOW), feedB.animate.set_color(YELLOW),
           lamp.animate.set_fill(YELLOW, opacity=0.9))
stage.caption("same wire: on")

beats.intent: Switch B flipped to the lower wire: the path breaks and the lamp goes dark
beats.narration: Flip either switch and they point to different wires. The path breaks and the light goes off, whichever end you are at.
beats.code:
stage.play(Transform(swB, Line([3.2, 0, 0], [2, -1, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)),
           wires[0].animate.set_color(GREY_B), feedA.animate.set_color(GREY_B), feedB.animate.set_color(GREY_B),
           lamp.animate.set_fill(opacity=0))
stage.caption("different wires: off")

request: why does a cyclist lean into a corner?

beats.intent: A cyclist drawn as a leaning line on a wheel, going round a curve
beats.narration: Riding round a corner, a cyclist leans in towards the centre of the turn.
beats.code:
stage.title("Leaning into a corner")
ground = Line([-4, -2.2, 0], [4, -2.2, 0], color=GREY_B)
wheel = Circle(radius=0.35, color=WHITE).move_to([0, -1.85, 0])
body = Line([0, -1.85, 0], [-1.2, 1.2, 0], color=ORANGE, stroke_width=10)
head = Circle(radius=0.28, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([-1.3, 1.5, 0])
stage.play(Create(ground), Create(wheel), Create(body), FadeIn(head))
stage.add(ground, wheel, body, head)
centre = Dot([-4.5, -2.2, 0], color=GREY_B)
stage.add(centre)
stage.label(centre, "centre of turn", direction=UP, color=GREY_B)

beats.intent: Arrows at the tyre: the road's push up and its sideways grip inward, adding to a push along the lean
beats.narration: The road pushes up on the tyre and grips it sideways, towards the centre. Together those pushes point along the leaning bike.
beats.code:
up = Arrow([0, -2.2, 0], [0, 0.6, 0], buff=0, color=BLUE)
grip = Arrow([0, -2.2, 0], [-1.1, -2.2, 0], buff=0, color=GREEN)
total = Arrow([0, -2.2, 0], [-1.1, 0.6, 0], buff=0, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(GrowArrow(up), GrowArrow(grip))
stage.play(GrowArrow(total))
stage.add(up, grip, total)
stage.label(up, "support", direction=RIGHT, color=BLUE)
stage.label(grip, "grip", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The picture beside tan θ = v² / (g r)
beats.narration: If that total push runs through the rider's centre of mass, there is no twist to tip them over. Faster or tighter turns need a bigger lean.
